text_block_list.text:
The day of the Flora Stakes. A race to 
gauge Ikuno Dictus's aptitude for medium 
distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To a highly motivated Ikuno Dictus, 
Daiichi Ruby, walking the same Tiara path, 
calls out to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby declares war. Yet Ikuno 
Dictus doesn't flinch in the slightest. 
How will this showdown play out—
